name: gui_build_ltc
description: GB-3 target B (a rectangular area light with linearly transformed cosines), from File > New Project > Blank with Studio's GUI only. As gui_build_D: a deferred_geometry_v1 material pass from the palette, a Cube and a Floor, Add fullscreen pass, Uses scene lights, New... > Deferred lighting > Create (the G-buffer wired by the template), its colour onto present's + input. The LTC lighting is written into the project as shaders/ltc_lighting.frag (an editor of one's own) and picked from the pass's Fragment list. The fitted LTC tables are not used (no way to load an image file into a render target): the GGX lobe is a normalised clamped cosine about the mirror direction; the rectangle's corners are constants in the shader (a render.scalar, value.constant or value.input from the palette is refused for its missing target / value / name, which no field writes); its radiance is the KeyLight's colour times intensity. Pixels: the floor where the light is mirrored is not the template's colour, and the points left and right of the reflection are not its colour (the reflection keeps the light's shape); Intensity 2 typed in the Inspector changes the reflection. Typed: the project folder and name, material_pass in the palette's filter, and 2 in the light's intensity.
